entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I... I need to return something. It's a pair of mountain bike shoes I bought a little while ago.

I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit, I think. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I saved up for these specific cycling shoes. But no matter what I do, they just... they hurt. They've given me terrible blisters on my heels.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers.
Yeah, and I could never get the cleats positioned right either, my feet kept aching. I just feel so disappointed. I really needed this money back, I was hoping I could still get a refund.
I completely understand your frustration. Let me pull up your order and check the policy for you. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your account?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like they were delivered about 67 days ago. Let me just confirm our current policy.
Alright, I've checked. Since it's a standard item, it falls within our 90-day return window. You are absolutely eligible for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried.

Of course. We want you to be happy with your gear. I've just initiated the return process and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email. Just pack the shoes in any box, attach the label, and drop it at a post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help today. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was it. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
